module vending (input clk, input rst, input [2:0] coin, input cancel, output reg dispense, output reg [2:0] change);
  reg [2:0] sum;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    dispense <= 1'b0;
    change <= 3'd0;
    if (rst) sum <= 3'd0;
    else if (cancel) begin change <= sum; sum <= 3'd0; end
    else if (coin != 3'd0) begin
      case (coin)
        3'b001: if (sum + 3'd1 >= 3'd5) begin dispense <= 1'b1; change <= sum + 3'd1 - 3'd5; sum <= 3'd0; end
                else sum <= sum + 3'd1;
        3'b010: if (sum + 3'd2 >= 3'd5) begin dispense <= 1'b1; change <= sum + 3'd2 - 3'd5; sum <= 3'd0; end
                else sum <= sum + 3'd2;
        3'b100: if (sum + 3'd5 >= 3'd5) begin dispense <= 1'b1; change <= sum + 3'd5 - 3'd5; sum <= 3'd0; end
                else sum <= sum + 3'd5;
        default: ;
      endcase
    end
  end
endmodule

</answer>

module arbiter_rr (input clk, input rst, input [3:0] req, output reg [3:0] grant);
  reg [1:0] last;
  reg [3:0] g;
  reg [1:0] ln;
  reg found;
  integer i;
  always @(*) begin
    g = 4'd0; ln = last; found = 1'b0;
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin
      if (req[(last + 2'd1 + i) % 4] && !found) begin
        g = 4'b1 << ((last + 2'd1 + i) % 4);
        ln = (last + 2'd1 + i) % 4;
        found = 1'b1;
      end
    end
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin grant <= 4'd0; last <= 2'd0; end
    else begin
      grant <= g;
      if (found) last <= ln;
    end
  end
endmodule

</answer>

module uart_tx (input clk, input rst, input send, input [7:0] data, output reg tx, output reg busy);
  reg active;
  reg [3:0] bit_cnt;
  reg [3:0] bit_idx;
  reg [7:0] sr;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin tx <= 1'b1; busy <= 1'b0; active <= 1'b0; bit_cnt <= 4'd0; bit_idx <= 4'd0; sr <= 8'd0; end
    else if (!active) begin
      if (send) begin active <= 1'b1; busy <= 1'b1; sr <= data; bit_idx <= 4'd0; bit_cnt <= 4'd0; tx <= 1'b0; end
      else begin tx <= 1'b1; busy <= 1'b0; end
    end else begin
      if (bit_cnt == 4'd15) begin
        bit_cnt <= 4'd0;
        if (bit_idx == 4'd9) begin active <= 1'b0; busy <= 1'b0; tx <= 1'b1; end
        else begin
          if (bit_idx == 4'd8) tx <= 1'b1;
          else tx <= sr[bit_idx];
          bit_idx <= bit_idx + 4'd1;
        end
      end else bit_cnt <= bit_cnt + 4'd1;
    end
  end
endmodule

</answer>

module uart_rx (input clk, input rst, input rx, output reg [7:0] data, output reg valid, output reg frame_err);
  localparam IDLE = 2'd0, START = 2'd1, DATA = 2'd2, STOP = 2'd3;
  reg [1:0] state;
  reg [3:0] cnt;
  reg [2:0] idx;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    valid <= 1'b0;
    frame_err <= 1'b0;
    if (rst) begin state <= IDLE; cnt <= 4'd0; idx <= 3'd0; data <= 8'd0; end
    else case (state)
      IDLE: begin
        if (!rx) begin state <= START; cnt <= 4'd0; end
      end
      START: begin
        if (cnt == 4'd7) begin
          if (!rx) begin state <= DATA; cnt <= 4'd0; idx <= 3'd0; end
          else state <= IDLE;
        end else cnt <= cnt + 4'd1;
      end
      DATA: begin
        if (cnt == 4'd15) begin
          cnt <= 4'd0;
          if (idx == 3'd7) state <= STOP;
          else idx <= idx + 3'd1;
        end else if (cnt == 4'd8) begin data[idx] <= rx; cnt <= cnt + 4'd1; end
        else cnt <= cnt + 4'd1;
      end
      STOP: begin
        if (cnt == 4'd15) begin state <= IDLE; cnt <= 4'd0; valid <= 1'b1; end
        else begin
          if (cnt == 4'd8) frame_err <= ~rx;
          cnt <= cnt + 4'd1;
        end
      end
    endcase
  end
endmodule

</answer>

module spi_master (input clk, input rst, input send, input [7:0] data, output reg sck, output reg mosi, output reg cs, output reg busy);
  reg active;
  reg [3:0] idx;
  reg sub;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin cs <= 1'b1; sck <= 1'b0; mosi <= 1'b0; busy <= 1'b0; active <= 1'b0; idx <= 4'd0; sub <= 1'b0; end
    else if (!active) begin
      if (send) begin active <= 1'b1; busy <= 1'b1; cs <= 1'b0; idx <= 4'd0; sub <= 1'b0; mosi <= data[7]; end
      else begin cs <= 1'b1; sck <= 1'b0; end
    end else begin
      if (sub == 1'b0) begin sub <= 1'b1; sck <= 1'b1; end
      else begin
        sub <= 1'b0; sck <= 1'b0;
        if (idx == 4'd7) begin active <= 1'b0; busy <= 1'b0; cs <= 1'b1; end
        else begin idx <= idx + 4'd1; mosi <= data[7 - (idx + 4'd1)]; end
      end
    end
  end
endmodule

</answer>

module digital_lock (input clk, input rst, input [3:0] digit, input enter, output reg unlocked, output reg err);
  reg [1:0] matched;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    err <= 1'b0;
    if (rst) begin matched <= 2'd0; unlocked <= 1'b0; end
    else if (enter) begin
      if (unlocked) begin end
      else case (matched)
        2'd0: if (digit == 4'd1) matched <= 2'd1; else begin err <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd0; end
        2'd1: if (digit == 4'd2) matched <= 2'd2; else begin err <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd0; end
        2'd2: if (digit == 4'd3) begin unlocked <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd3; end
              else begin err <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd0; end
        default: ;
      endcase
    end
  end
endmodule

</answer>
